title: A one-off question with no durable outcome
turns: Quick one: I'm meeting Tavi Brennock tomorrow at 16:30 Lisbon time. What time is that in Tokyo?
Thanks. Can you also tell me how many minutes are in 3.5 hours?

answer_key.reference: Nothing durable happened: the person asked a one-off time-zone conversion for a meeting tomorrow and a unit conversion. No page should change and no recap or other page should be written.
